# Nutrition notes

## Status

Resting heart rate is down to 40 after three months. Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner. Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine.

## Open questions

Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week. Frank joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day. Intervals on Wednesday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest.

## Next steps

Drink before the long run, take a gel after one hour. Physio exercises: clamshells, bridges, calf raises. Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent.

## Context

- Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.
- Race goal is to finish under two hours, without walking.
